title: Reported speech: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: "Sit down," the teacher said. → The teacher told us ___ down.
items.explanationEs: Una orden: told + persona + to + verbo.

items.text: "Are you hungry?" she asked me. → She asked me ___ hungry.
items.explanationEs: Pregunta de sí o no: if + sujeto + verbo un paso atrás (are → was).

items.text: "I can't come tomorrow," Ana said last week. → Ana said she ___ come the next day.
items.explanationEs: Can da un paso atrás: could. Lo dijo la semana pasada, así que ya es pasado.

items.text: "Where is the station?" he asked. → He asked where the station ___.
items.explanationEs: Orden de afirmación (the station was). Is también vale: la estación sigue en el mismo sitio.

answers: He told me he was tired.
He told me that he was tired.
items.explanationEs: Me dijo es told me (tell + a quién). Estoy → estaba: am → was. That se puede quitar.

items.sentence: He said me that he was tired.
items.explanationEs: Con a quién (me), tell: He told me…
